contracts.input_semantics: Existing immutable task identity and a nonempty worker identity in the local reference store.
contracts.output_semantics: A durable claim with a unique monotonically issued fencing epoch; issuance advances the target fence for that effect.
contracts.error_semantics: Unknown tasks and malformed identities raise SemanticError; SQLite transaction arbitration serializes concurrent issuers.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Claim creation grants no permission and authorizes no effect.
contracts.effect_semantics: Durably creates a Claimed attempt and advances the local reference target fence.

contracts.input_semantics: Exact claim identity plus fixture permission and revocation state.
contracts.output_semantics: Claim becomes Permitted only while fixture permission is present and not revoked.
contracts.error_semantics: Rebound claims or unavailable permission raise SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Missing authority is denial; fixture permission is not an external grant.
contracts.effect_semantics: Changes only local attempt state; performs no target effect.

contracts.input_semantics: Exact Permitted claim, current fixture permission, nonrevoked state, immutable effect identity and current fencing epoch.
contracts.output_semantics: One idempotent local target effect is committed; acknowledgment may be observed or explicitly lost as Uncertain.
contracts.error_semantics: Stale epoch, revoked permission, rebound identity or non-Permitted state raises SemanticError; stale rejection is durably traced.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Lost acknowledgment remains Uncertain and is never automatically redispatched.
contracts.effect_semantics: Atomic SQLite reference-target commit only; no distributed or physical target guarantee.

contracts.input_semantics: Exact Uncertain attempt and local committed-effect evidence or explicit authoritative nonexecution evidence.
contracts.output_semantics: Committed effect resolves Done; proven nonexecution resolves Idle for a future new claim.
contracts.error_semantics: Non-Uncertain attempts or ambiguous nonexecution raise SemanticError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Ambiguity remains Uncertain; absence of a receipt is not proof of nonexecution.
contracts.effect_semantics: Reconciles local durable state only and does not itself execute or compensate an effect.
